text.en: Opinions on the team are divided in recent months. Several owners describe staff as caring and supportive — particularly during emergencies and end-of-life appointments. Others report a lack of compassion and feeling rushed or dismissed. The practice appears to perform well in genuine emergency situations but receives criticism for day-to-day interactions.

A recurring theme in recent reviews is concern over pricing. Several owners describe charges they felt were disproportionate to the treatment received — including a fee for a basic temperature check with no medication given. A parking charge issued to a bereaved owner shortly after an out-of-hours visit was also mentioned critically.

A number of recent reviewers raise concerns about diagnostic thoroughness. Cases include owners feeling pressured into decisions during stressful moments, a dog redirected to another branch during an emergency, and a cat sent home without adequate assessment. Positive experiences — including a dog successfully revived after a seizure — also feature, but critical accounts are prominent.

a.en: Yes — the practice operates around the clock and reviewers describe being seen out of hours, including on bank holidays and late at night.
Several reviewers describe being seen promptly during emergencies. At least one reviewer notes being directed to call the animal poison hotline before being seen, which they found helpful.

q.en: Is there parking at the hospital?

a.en: There is a car park, though at least one reviewer received a parking charge notice following an out-of-hours visit.

q.en: Do they treat cats as well as dogs?

a.en: Yes — reviewers mention cats and dogs receiving care at this location, including end-of-life appointments, stray microchip checks, and emergency treatment.
